notes.title: Lupus in Fabula V 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Hello

Lupus in Fabula is now v1.0.8.[/b]

The possible fix for Win7 users where the game freeze on level with puffer-fish
exploding, please do let me know if this works for you in the 'troubleshooting' part of the forum.

Also, a fix for a President achievement, the text and picture did not show even tho the achievement was proper unlocked.

In case of any other problems with game, please post it in 'troubleshooting' and I'll see to it being philogrobolized (fixed) asap.

Enjoy~
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29113194/f39353976b56e6a7af0ce7d0b0741a454b28afd0.png[/img]

notes.title: Lupus in Fabula release
notes.notes:
[h1]Lupus in Fabula[/h1] is available as of today (July 13th), the latest version being 1.0.7.
Latest additions are stick control besides dpad gamepad navigation and 15 achievements added.

For the first week, the game is 10% off the regular price.
Enjoyeth!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29113194/ad395e4a8be14e30ebbd3f698d1e31ac8225fa3e.png[/img]
